candidates.title: The Mixed Seed Trays
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered the nursery's labeled seedlings grew into the wrong flowers before the final ferry, leaving the stranded travelers waiting.
Fox attempted an immediate fix, but they swapped the labels, but the next row was still mismatched; rabbit stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Rabbit examined the evidence and realized the trays had been rotated when the greenhouse roof was repaired; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the stranded travelers watching, they matched each seedling to the planting records and restored the rows, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

candidates.title: The Stuck Ferry Rope
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered the small ferry stopped halfway across the quiet channel before the final ferry, leaving the stranded travelers waiting.
Fox attempted an immediate fix, but they pulled harder, but the guide rope tightened around its wheel; rabbit stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Rabbit examined the evidence and realized a drifting branch had jammed the pulley beneath the deck; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.

With the stranded travelers watching, they cleared the branch from shore and tested the ferry before passengers boarded, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

candidates.title: The Silent Radio
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered the lookout radio stopped receiving the daily weather bulletin before the final ferry, leaving the stranded travelers waiting.
Fox attempted an immediate fix, but they replaced its batteries, but only faint static came through; rabbit stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Rabbit examined the evidence and realized a bent antenna connector had come loose during the last storm; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.
With the stranded travelers watching, they secured the connector and confirmed the bulletin with the lookout, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.
